'Total daily electronic screen time' (daily_screentime), mother report, two bands (<= 1 h, > 1 h); a dichotomous guideline cut gives no hours and the preregistration excludes dichotomous screen measures. Gaming time is on st_game.

Mother-reported daily video gaming time, asked of children who play 'video games on a computer, smartphone, tablet or game console' (indoors and out), usual day. Bands 20-30, 31-60 and 61-120 minutes at their midpoints (25, 45.5, 90.5 min / 60); top band '> 120 minutes' = 2. Never-gamers (video_gaming = 0, 140) are routed past the item and take 0 (non-users rule). By design the sample holds only never-gamers and children gaming at least 20 minutes a day for the past 6 months, sampled 1:2.

No all-device leisure item: the total screen-time item (daily_screentime) is not restricted to leisure and gives two bands only (see st_total), and the gaming item (daily_videogaming_time) is single-activity, on st_game.
